end.summary:
Practised naming common non-metals and identifying their states.
Reviewed everyday uses of graphite, chlorine, iodine, nitrogen, fertilisers, rocket fuel and balloons.
Pari gave 3 unaided-correct responses out of 4 for names and states, and 2 out of 2 for uses.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised non-metal names, states, and everyday uses with Pari. They correctly connected graphite with pencils and identified oxygen and nitrogen as gases, while identifying sulphur and iodine as solids. No recorded misconception was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Pari to sort the listed non-metals into solid, liquid, and gas, then match each with one use.
